code: new Promise(done=>{__echoes.cmd('teleport',0,0); const tel=[]; for(const t of ['telegraph_start','telegraph_resolve']) __echoes.on(t,ev=>tel.push(ev)); const ids=[]; const pts=[[3.2,0],[-3.2,0],[0,3.0],[0,-3.0],[2.3,2.3],[-2.3,-2.3],[2.3,-2.3],[-2.3,2.3]]; for(const [x,z] of pts) ids.push(__echoes.cmd('spawn','mantis',x,z)); setTimeout(()=>{const starts=tel.filter(e=>e.type==='telegraph_start'&&e.playerTargeted); const resolves=tel.filter(e=>e.type==='telegraph_resolve'&&e.playerTargeted).map(e=>e.tick).sort((a,b)=>a-b); let minResGap=1e9; for(let i=1;i<resolves.length;i++) minResGap=Math.min(minResGap,resolves[i]-resolves[i-1]); const st=starts.map(s=>s.tick).sort((a,b)=>a-b); let minStartGap=1e9; for(let i=1;i<st.length;i++) minStartGap=Math.min(minStartGap,st[i]-st[i-1]); let maxCon=0; for(const s of starts){let c=0; for(const o of starts){ if(o.tick<=s.tick && s.tick<o.resolveTick) c++; } maxCon=Math.max(maxCon,c);} const s2=__echoes.state(); done({nMantis:ids.length, nStarts:starts.length, nResolves:resolves.length, minStartGapTicks:minStartGap, minResolveGapTicks:minResGap, maxConcurrentPlayerTel:maxCon, playerHp:s2.party[0].hp, allyHp:s2.party.slice(1).map(p=>p.hp), fps:__echoes.fps, resolves});},16000);})
